title: elatostema heterolobum
intro: Elatostema heterolobum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Urticaceae family, is native to tropical regions. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Elatostema heterolobum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to exhibit potential anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects.
